component.name: LayerC
component.summary: Passive X11 overlay and command-line tools

description.p: LayerC runs passive, click-through cooldown, timer, counter and indicator panels on X11. It provides command-line tools for profile and bundle management, runtime control, and visual calibration without input injection or elevated privileges.
Applies the accessible LayerE design system and caps visual flashing at 3 Hz in every renderer. Wayland remains an unqualified preview.
Adds typed cooldown, timer, counter and indicator panel items. Wayland remains an unqualified preview.
